title: Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety of Lovaza (Omega-3-Acid Ethyl Esters) in Recurrent, Symptomatic Atrial Fibrillation

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to evaluate efficacy and safety of Omacor (omega-3-acid ethyl esters) in patients with recurrent, symptomatic atrial fibrillation.

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants With Paroxysmal AF With an Event of Documented Symptomatic Atrial Fibrillation (AF)/Flutter. timeframe=From first dose of study drug (Day 1) to the first symptomatic recurrence of AF/. Paroxysmal AF, Placebo=129; Paroxysmal AF, P-OM3=135. p=0.263
